name: Toolbar
summary: A labelled row of controls for one context, such as a text editor or a canvas. One tab stop, arrow keys between items, and a More tools menu for what does not fit.
useWhen: Several commands and toggles that act on one thing in view: the selected text, the canvas, a table
A set of tools a keyboard user should cross with one Tab and the arrow keys
A bar of icon tools that must survive a narrow window without wrapping
avoidWhen: Two or three related actions with no shared context
The actions of a form: submit and cancel

aria-label.description: Toolbar: required unless aria-labelledby names a visible heading. Names the context: Text formatting, Canvas tools.

size.description: Toolbar: passed to every item that does not set its own (xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 44 px at default density). A Link item takes sm at xs.

emphasis.description: Toolbar: passed to every Button and IconButton item that does not set its own. The toolbar draws its own quiet surface.

orientation.description: Toolbar: a row, or a column where the up and down arrows move. Separators run across it.

loop.description: Toolbar: the arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first.

overflow.description: Toolbar: menu measures the top level children; the ones that do not fit are hidden (data-overflowed) and appear in the More tools menu, where choosing one clicks the hidden item. wrap lets the row break onto more lines.

moreLabel.description: Toolbar: the name of the overflow trigger. Arabic default: أدوات أكثر. Name the context when the page has more than one toolbar: More text tools.

icon.description: ToolbarButton and ToolbarToggleItem: a system icon name. With it the item is an IconButton and label (its name) is required; without, a Button with a visible label.

label.description: ToolbarButton and ToolbarToggleItem with icon: the accessible name, a verb plus a noun.

disabled.description: Items: aria-disabled. The item keeps its place in the arrow key order and swallows the click.

type.description: ToolbarToggleGroup: multiple toggles each item on its own (aria-pressed): bold, italic. single keeps one at most on (radio semantics): alignment.

value.description: ToolbarToggleGroup (a string, or a list for multiple) with onValueChange; ToolbarToggleItem: its value.

a11y.role: toolbar with a name and aria-orientation. Groups are role group with a name; toggle items are buttons with aria-pressed (multiple) or radio with aria-checked (single). The overflow trigger is a menu button.
a11y.focus: One tab stop: the last focused item, else the first. Arrow keys move between items, groups included. Hidden (overflowed) items cannot take focus and are skipped.

keys.Tab: Moves focus into the toolbar, to one item
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus out of the toolbar
keys.ArrowRight: Moves to the next item. In right to left layouts this is ArrowLeft. Wraps at the end
keys.ArrowLeft: Moves to the previous item. In right to left layouts this is ArrowRight
keys.ArrowDown, ArrowUp: In a vertical toolbar, move to the next and the previous item
keys.End: Moves to the last item, the More tools trigger when it shows
keys.Enter, Space: Runs the focused item, toggles a toggle item, or opens the More tools menu

a11y.announce: The toolbar is read with its name when focus enters. Each item reads its name, its pressed state and whether it is disabled. The More tools trigger reads as a menu button.
notes: Icon only items name their action through label (aria-label). A Tooltip with the same words belongs on each one once Tooltip (1.6.6) is merged; until then there is no visible hint, and no native title attribute.
Disabled items use aria-disabled and stay in the arrow key order, so a keyboard user learns they exist.
A toggle item that is on is drawn filled; in forced colors a Highlight frame marks it, and aria-pressed carries it for assistive tech.
Overflow keeps the page from scrolling sideways (WCAG 1.4.10): the toolbar is never wider than its container.
Every item is a system Button, IconButton or Link: 24px targets at xs, 44px at lg (WCAG 2.5.8).
Contract keys: arrows, Home and End are checked by hints; Enter and Space run on the items, which are Buttons with their own contract.
open and closed are the data-state of the More tools trigger, from DropdownMenu.

en.toolbar: Name the context with a noun phrase: Text formatting, Canvas tools.
en.items: Verb plus noun: Add frame, Zoom in. Toggle items name the option: Bold, Show grid.
en.more: More tools, or More text tools when two toolbars share a page.

ar.items: Noun form labels, white Saudi dialect, no diacritics: إضافة إطار، تكبير، حذف الإطار.

react.note: Items are system Button, IconButton and Link roots through Radix asChild. Toggle groups use Radix ToolbarToggleGroup until ToggleButton and ToggleGroup (batch 1) are merged; then ToolbarToggleItem should render a ToggleButton. The overflow menu is the system DropdownMenu, which plays menu-scale.

angular.behavior: cdk:a11y (FocusKeyManager) and cdk:menu for the overflow

styles.studio: A surface-2 bar with a subtle hairline and the panel radius, ghost items, a 1px separator.
styles.desk: The same parts on Desk tokens; items take the Desk Button look (pills).
styles.neutral: Token driven; applies once the Neutral pack is merged.

mistakes.right: aria-label naming the context: Text formatting

mistakes.wrong: Every item a separate tab stop
mistakes.right: Toolbar: one tab stop and the arrow keys

mistakes.wrong: A row of tools that pushes the page wider on a phone
mistakes.right: overflow menu, the default: the rest moves into More tools

mistakes.wrong: Pressed state shown only by a color change
mistakes.right: ToolbarToggleItem: aria-pressed and the filled on state

mistakes.wrong: Hiding a tool that cannot run now
mistakes.right: disabled: it stays in the row with aria-disabled

mistakes.wrong: An icon only item named More
mistakes.right: Name the action: Open review settings
